summary: 街头足球让孩子在自行组队、接受同伴评价和反复试错中学会技巧与合作。文章解释城市空间、安全顾虑和成人安排如何压缩自由踢球的机会，并比较街头比赛与正规青少年联赛的教育方式。

paragraphs.brief: 街头足球，如其名称所暗示的那样，是这种运动的一种非正式的变体，经常在街头、特别是在城市地区进行。
sentences: Street soccer, as its name implies, is an informal variation of the sport, often played on the street, particularly in urban areas.
街头足球，如其名称所暗示的那样，是这种运动的一种非正式的变体，经常在街头、特别是在城市地区进行。
There are many reasons for the widespread popularity of street soccer.
街头足球受到广泛欢迎有许多原因。

Unlike youth soccer, its more formally organized counterpart, no large space is needed, and goal posts, corner markers, and marked lines, associated with the formal game, are typically absent, as are game officials or referees.
与青年足球不同，青年足球组织较正规，不需要大空间，目标海报、角标和标志线与正规游戏相关，通常没有，游戏官员或裁判也是如此。
Another attraction of street soccer is that it is played frequently and competitively, but does not necessarily require standard 11-a-side teams or fixed playing positions.
街头足球的另一个吸引力是，它经常和有竞争力地进行比赛，但不一定需要标准的11人球队或固定的球场。
Unlike in youth soccer, inexperienced street soccer players rarely learn from repetitive technical and tactical drills.
与青年足球不同的是，没有经验的街头足球运动员很少从重复的技术和战术演习中学习。
Instead, they learn from their poor performance in competition, unconscious of the skills they are nonetheless developing, and without older adults or coaches present.
相反，他们从竞争表现不佳、对其正在发展的技能失去意识以及没有老年人或教练在场的情况中学习。
Players learn without effort through playing the game, and soon attain an almost natural feeling for the sport.
玩家不费力地通过玩游戏来学习，并且很快对这项运动有几乎自然的感觉。

paragraphs.brief: 此外，许多地方要求官方许可使用公共空间以及许多青年人今天的管理时间表，因此难以想象任何类型的自发游戏。
sentences: However, there are lots of cities in the world today where conditions are such that street soccer is no longer possible.
然而，当今世界有许多城市的条件如此恶劣，街头足球已不再可能。
Congested traffic now dominates where games were once played.
堵塞的交通现在主导着曾经玩过的游戏。
Parks and open fields are used as hangouts for older teenagers with other interests.
公园和露天田地被用作有其他兴趣的年长青少年的宿营地。

Add to this the requirement in many localities for official permits to use public spaces and the managed schedules that many young people have today, and spontaneous play of any kind is hard to imagine.
此外，许多地方要求官方许可使用公共空间以及许多青年人今天的管理时间表，因此难以想象任何类型的自发游戏。

paragraphs.brief: 尽管存在这些障碍，多数情况下或许是可以解决的，但也有另一个社会学上的解释，说明为什么在许多地方街头足球没有像以前那样受到同样的欢迎。
sentences: In spite of all these obstacles, which are probably solvable in most instances, there is another sociological explanation of why in many places street soccer doesn’t enjoy the same popularity it once did.
尽管存在这些障碍，多数情况下或许是可以解决的，但也有另一个社会学上的解释，说明为什么在许多地方街头足球没有像以前那样受到同样的欢迎。
In his book How Soccer Explains the World, US writer Franklin Foer observes: But for all the talk of freedom, the 1960s parenting style had a far less relaxed side too.
美国作家富兰克林·福尔在其著作《足球如何解释世界》中指出：但是，对于自由的谈论，1960年代的养育方式也有少得多松懈的一面。

Like the 1960s consumer movement which brought seat belts and airbags to cars, the (youth) soccer movement felt like it could create a set of … regulations that would protect both the child’s body and mind from damage.
与1960年代消费者运动把安全带和气囊带到汽车上一样，(青年)足球运动感觉可以制定一套条例，保护儿童的身体和心灵不受破坏。
Soccer leagues like the one I played in as a child handed out ‘participation’ prizes to every player, no matter how few games his (or her) team won.
足球联赛就像我小时候玩过的联赛一样，向每个球员颁发了“参与”奖项，不管球队赢得多少比赛。

Where most of the world accepts the practice of using your head to hit the ball as an essential element of the game, some (youth) soccer parents have worried over the potential for injury to the brain.
在世界上大部分地区都接受用你的头打球来作为游戏的基本要素的地方有些(年轻的)足球家长担心大脑可能受伤
An entire industry grew up to manufacture protective headgear.
整个工业都成长为制造防护帽。
Even though very little medical evidence supports this fear, some youth leagues prohibited heading the ball altogether.
尽管医疗证据很少支持这种恐惧，但一些青年联盟禁止参加舞会。

paragraphs.brief: 越来越多的人不相信街头足球会是合法的教育方法。
sentences: A growing body of people don’t believe street soccer involves a legitimate educational method.
越来越多的人不相信街头足球会是合法的教育方法。
They argue that children need to be taught by experts.
他们争辩说，儿童需要由专家来教授。
Youth soccer instruction now begins with four-year-olds, so that they will have an advantage as six-year-olds.
青年足球教育现在从4岁开始，这样他们就能作为6岁的孩子获得优势。
This need to get ahead brings with it a fear of falling behind that only expert instruction can prevent.
这样做的必要性带来了一种恐惧，担心落后于只有专家才能防止的指令。
This type of instruction leaves no room for the trial-and-error approach of street soccer.
这种教学方式没有为街头足球的试探和磨难留有余地。

paragraphs.brief: 街头足球的基本理念之一是，年轻球员被一个更好的球员指定担任一个特殊的角色，并被要求为球队的利益而发挥这一作用。
sentences: One of the basic ideas of street soccer is that young players are assigned a particular role by a better player and are expected to play for the good of the team.
街头足球的基本理念之一是，年轻球员被一个更好的球员指定担任一个特殊的角色，并被要求为球队的利益而发挥这一作用。
Such an assignment runs counter to the idea of youth soccer that every child needs to learn every position and will benefit from doing so.
这种任务与青年足球的想法背道而驰，即每个儿童需要学习每一个位置，并且从中得益。
In street soccer, you fill the role that you are best able to at a particular time.
在街头足球中，你扮演的角色在某个时候你最能胜任
While this role assignment can change from game to game, the purpose is always the same: to get the best out of each individual at any given moment.
虽然这一角色分配可以从游戏改变为游戏，但目的总是相同的：在任何特定时刻从每个人身上得到最好的。

paragraphs.brief: 在街头足球中，儿童必须学会耐心，等待轮到他们，认识到他们无权作出决定，甚至仅仅因为出现就听从他们的意见。
sentences: In street soccer, children have to learn patience, to wait their turn, to realize that they are not entitled to make decisions, or even be listened to simply because they show up.
在街头足球中，儿童必须学会耐心，等待轮到他们，认识到他们无权作出决定，甚至仅仅因为出现就听从他们的意见。
Positions of responsibility are earned through competition within the team.
负责职位是通过团队内部的竞争获得的。
Younger players in street soccer must wait to attain those positions.
街头足球队的年轻球员必须等待到达这些位置。
In youth soccer, however, with its overly democratic values, youngsters are guaranteed their time in the spotlight.
然而，在青年足球中，由于它过于民主的价值观，年轻人在聚光灯下的时间得到保障。
Whether it’s their turn to be captain, to play a central position or to take a crucial shot, youth soccer players come to believe that hard work and patience aren’t really necessary.
无论是轮到他们当队长，扮演一个中心位置或采取一个关键镜头，青年足球运动员开始相信，勤劳和耐心并不真正需要。

paragraphs.brief: 不仅每个青年足球运动员都有机会，还假定每个人都打得很好。
sentences: Not only does every youth soccer player get a chance, it is assumed that each individual has played well.
不仅每个青年足球运动员都有机会，还假定每个人都打得很好。
‘Everyone’s a winner; no one’s a loser’ is a guiding principle of youth soccer.
“每个人都是赢家；没有人是输家”是青年足球的指导原则。
This ensures each individual goes away positive about themselves.
这确保了每个人对自己的积极性。
No one can leave a game or a practice feeling bad.
没有人能离开一场比赛或一个有不好的感觉的练习。
But, if there really are no losers, then why try at all?
但是，如果真的没有失败者，那么为什么还要尝试呢？
Since giving less than your best receives the same reward as giving your best, why go to any extra effort?
既然付出的比最好的还少得到的奖励和付出的一样为什么要再努力呢？
In street soccer, every game results in a winner and a loser and everyone knows who is who.
在街头足球赛中，每场比赛都会有赢家和输家所有人都知道是谁
Losing a game is a common experience and players learn early on how to handle this.
输球是常见的经验玩家早早学会怎么应付
As a result, unlike most youth soccer players, they acquire resilience.
因此，与大多数青年足球运动员不同，他们获得复原力。
A further difference between these two strands of soccer is that in street soccer a formal record is not kept.
这两类足球之间的另一个区别是，在街头足球中，没有正式记录。
You can lose one day and win the next.
你输了一天，就赢了第二天
The results are only temporary and are forgotten within minutes of the end of the match.
结果只是暂时的，在比赛结束后几分钟内被遗忘。
But in organized youth soccer, the position each person plays and the results are formally noted and maintained throughout a season.
但是，在有组织的青年足球中，每个人的姿势和结果都得到正式的注意并在整个季节保持。

items.en: a contrast between the ways young players gain experience of playing different positions
items.zh: 比较年轻球员通过哪些不同方式获得踢不同位置的经验。
items.why: 先讲街头足球按能力分工，再对比青少年足球“人人轮岗"一正是“获得不同位置经验的对比”。

items.en: examples outside sport of greater emphasis on individual safety
items.zh: 举出体育以外的例子，说明人们更加重视个人安全。
items.why: 段C用汽车安全带、气圳为跨领域 (体育之外) 的安全重视实例。

items.en: a description of methods of selection for leadership on soccer teams
items.zh: 介绍足球队如何选出队伍的带头人。
items.why: 球员靠队内竞争赢得承担责任的位置，而不是一开始就有权发号施令。

items.en: details of urban changes that discourage street soccer
items.zh: 指出哪些城市环境变化妨碍了街头足球活动。
items.why: 罗列城市交通、场地用途、许可制度等城市变化如何妨碍街头足球。

items.en: a mention of the lesson that failure teaches street soccer players
items.zh: 提到街头足球运动员可以从失败中学到什么。
items.why: 街头比赛中输球很常见，孩子很早就学会如何面对失败；这就是失利教会他们的事。

items.en: an explanation of why youth soccer emphasises the need for coaches
items.zh: 解释青少年足球为何特别强调教练的重要性。
items.why: 担心孩子落后，使人们相信只有专家指导才能帮助他们跟上，解释了为何青少年足球强调教练。

items.en: The list below gives some possible reasons for the popularity of street soccer. Which TWO of these reasons are mentioned by the writer of the text?
items.zh: 作者提到了街头足球受欢迎的哪两个原因？
correct: You do not need elaborate facilities to play street soccer.
踢街头足球不需要复杂的场地或设施。
Street soccer teams can have varying numbers of players.
街头足球每队的人数可以灵活变化。

items.en: The list below gives some possible results of the 1960s parenting style. Which TWO of these results are mentioned by Franklin Foer in the excerpt from How Soccer Explains the World?
items.zh: 富兰克林·福尔在《足球如何解释世界》的节选中提到，20 世纪 60 年代的育儿方式产生了哪两个结果？
correct: Some youth soccer leagues adopted more restrictive rules of play.
一些青少年足球联赛采用了限制更多的比赛规则。
Youth soccer players were sometimes rewarded for simply playing in games.
有时小球员只要上场参赛就能得到奖励。

items.en: Winners and losers For youth soccer players, a key ________ is that they should always come away from the game with a positive attitude.
items.zh: 青少年足球有一条重要的________，就是球员每次比赛结束时都应保持积极的心态。
items.why: 回到对应内容““每个人都是赢家；没有人是输家”是青年足球的指导原则”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: In this respect, regardless of the effort the players make, they get some kind of ________ at the end of a game.
items.zh: 因此，不论付出多少努力，球员在赛后都会得到某种________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“既然付出的比最好的还少得到的奖励和付出的一样为什么要再努力呢？”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: In fact, no-one ever keeps a ________ of the results of games.
items.zh: 事实上，从来没有人把比赛结果做成________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“这两类足球之间的另一个区别是，在街头足球中，没有正式记录”，再按题干要求写出答案。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 原文通过队里承担责任的职位来说明怎样选出领导者。
题干谈体验不同位置，原文用少年球员学习每个位置来呈现这种主张。
points: 段C用汽车安全带、气圳为跨领域 (体育之外) 的安全重视实例。
回到对应内容“这两类足球之间的另一个区别是，在街头足球中，没有正式记录”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: In street soccer, you fill the role ….
“that you are best able to at a particular time”修饰前面的 role。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 role，再把修饰信息接回主句。
…, the purpose is always the same: to get the best out of each individual at any given moment.
连接词 while 引出“While this role assignment can change from game to game”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: There are many differences between playing soccer in the street and joining a youth team in an organized league in the USA
在街头踢足球和加入一个青年团队在美国有组织的联盟之间有很多不同
